items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Bill Johnson's been to California again, they tell me. I haven't seen Bill Johnson in the middle.

ctx.x: You might have met him, a tall, light fellow, played trombone.

I've heard that name. Faith, what is his name? I don't know whether he's going to see. Somebody played with... He played with Bill Johnson in them, too. I think he's played with Ice Can Tate, too. He played with Bill Johnson in them out there, I think, too. Really? I've never met him. Bill Johnson's been to California again, they tell me. I haven't seen Bill Johnson in the middle. Is he back now? Yeah, he's back now. I haven't got to see. He said a man can't get a job in California if he don't belong to that…

He's such a friendly fellow. What is his address? I don't know for sure. I have it at home. I'll try to find it. Yeah? I'll make a note of it right now. Yeah. I have it at home. Unless he's moved. I haven't seen him for about six or seven years. I see. Well, he was supposed to come here this winter. There was one trumpet player, a white kid, who had a band. And when he left Ory, he was going to get him to come here in June. But Garland didn't come with him. Oh, I guess. Maybe June. Because he didn't want to…
